visual.detailed_description: Close-up color photograph. Four fingers and the base of the thumb of a hand enter from the top of the frame and press the fingertips onto a rounded, smooth area of skin that fills the lower two thirds of the image. A cream-colored piece of fabric, which appears to be a garment or cloth, lies around the hand and the skin area at the top, left and right. A green-teal cloth drape is visible at the left and right edges. No face, no genitalia, no wound, deformity, bruise or other skin lesion is visible. No printed text, labels, arrows, scale or panel letters are visible.

visual.general_description: Color close-up photograph of a syringe held in one gloved hand with its needle at the skin surface while another gloved hand holds gauze.
visual.detailed_description: Close-up color photograph. A white-gloved hand at the top holds a piece of white gauze against the skin. At the lower left a second, blurred translucent-gloved hand holds the barrel of a syringe. The syringe has a clear barrel, graduation marks that are not legible and a teal-colored hub. Its needle points toward a small dark spot on the skin surface near the gauze. The skin occupies most of the frame, with a green-teal drape along the lower right and a metal dish at the upper left. No face, genitalia, printed labels, arrows or panel letters are visible.
